IPT.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/7] Facilitators and co-facilitators first read the published efficacy trials to introduce them to the major concepts involved in the CB depression prevention program and then read the CB and supportive-expressive intervention scripts.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/8] Dr. Rohde rated recordings of the sessions for adherence and competence using scales adapted from prior trials (Rohde et al., 2004).

MedCat.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/8] Dr. Rohde rated recordings of the sessions for adherence and competence using scales adapted from prior trials (Rohde et al., 2004).
MedCat.warning: The measures 'adherence' and 'facilitator competence' are process measures of intervention delivery, not youth-level mediators or outcomes, and thus do not fit any defined MedCat category.
